create_random_erasing: create a RandomErasing augmentation instance with const mode and 0.5 probability for image data augmentation
build_random_erasing_cube: build a RandomErasing instance with cube mode enabled for batched video tensor erasing
test_random_erasing_call: test the RandomErasing __call__ method on a 3D single image tensor input
run_random_erasing_batch: run RandomErasing on a 4D batched image tensor with rand pixel color mode
configure_random_erasing_params: configure RandomErasing with custom min_area, max_area, min_aspect, and max_count parameters
